response.original_title: How do I add a passenger on a Regent Seven Seas Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Regent Seven Seas Cruises reservation, contact customer service at +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or +44-289-708-0062 (UK), or reach out to your travel advisor, as additions cannot be made online.  Key Considerations  Availability & Capacity: Additions depend on stateroom berth capacity and the ship's maximum safety limits.  Pricing & Details: The booking will be re-priced at prevailing rates with current fees. Have your booking number, the new guest's legal name, and date of birth ready.  Rules & Timeline: At least one original guest must remain, and requests should be made early to meet manifest deadlines.
